teachingQuestion: Which layers must work together for an authentication system to remain trustworthy after login?
focalInsight: A directory, protocol, authenticator, session, authorization, and accounting layer each solve a different part of the end-to-end control.
title: Authentication-system layers
caption: The system is stronger when every layer has a clear owner, protected interface, and failure response.
altSummary: A stack links identity source, authentication protocol, authenticator, authorization, session and revocation, and accounting evidence.
textFallback: The identity source provides records; the protocol exchanges and verifies evidence; the authenticator supplies factors; authorization decides the action; session controls preserve and revoke access; accounting records attempts and activity. Weakness in any layer can undermine the whole system.
